name: Nexo Tesis
distribution: standalone Windows Python application; not Nexo PC update
runtime_dependencies: Python >=3.11 stdlib/Tk/SQLite; bundled websocket-client 1.9.2 and pypdf 6.21.2; Windows PowerShell and desktop Word for native Word operations; existing Microsoft client or Edge for optional Copilot login
model_providers: Copilot365 (continuidad por defecto; recuerdo remoto no verificado)

per_turn_limits.model_requests: 2 logical generation phases; 6 transport attempts default per execution cycle

academic.flow: conversation-first; structured model proposals with host validation
academic.draft_invalidation_on_fact_changes: Content facts invalidate; guide typography does not indiscriminately invalidate drafts
academic.source_scope: Crossref metadata/abstracts, user excerpts and permission-scoped local file excerpts; returned Copilot references separately unverified
academic.guide_rule_detection: partial pattern-based proposals with evidence/scope/strength, explicit selection and approval

actions: prepare excerpt as unsent chat message
insert approved text with tracked changes
create/update native automatic table of contents
read library DOCX copy read-only with native Word
reviewed guide profile in layout and insertion

validation.model_responses: scripted fixtures; socket tests use loopback emulator

context_fixture.fixture: synthetic 11 known facts, 11 answered questions, 15 sources, 8 drafts, 8 messages; no actual user content
context_fixture.measure: Unicode characters, not tokens or cost; not a quality benchmark

validation.local_continuity_tests: 331 unit tests passed, 2 skipped; synthetic fixtures only; Tk/Xvfb not run

fixes: Project file library, reading state, version/provenance and route-scoped excerpt grants
Reviewed guide profile and selected optional sections
Short task contracts and compact selective context
Greeting-topic prevention and legacy pending-topic flag
Returned Copilot citations retained as unverified metadata

Continuidad Copilot 0.4.1-dev: hilo durable por defecto, sin rotacion a los 40 turnos, recuperacion y revocacion con decision explicita, cabecera de afinidad aislada y contexto incremental solo tras verificacion
Revocation also excludes tracked derived context from unauthorized routes
Anteproyecto does not schedule final empirical results solely because diagnostic data are present
Unknown bibliography years no longer become literal None; peer-review reports filtered
Copilot365 sin API key: el formulario de Cuentas oculta la clave, Guardar cuenta inicia Conectar escritorio M365 y Guardar y usar ofrece la conexion en lugar de pedir credenciales

Tolerancia de formato: se valida un unico objeto JSON completo aunque venga envuelto en texto o cerca json, se unifican los contratos de tarea e incremental y el aviso de error indica un motivo fijo sin volcar la respuesta del modelo

copilot_continuity.affinity_header: X-RoutingParameter-SessionKey on opening handshake; isolated A/B flag; third-party evidence, NOT verified by Microsoft or by this project
copilot_continuity.incremental_messages: only after explicit user verification on Copilot-only routes; full context otherwise
copilot_continuity.uncertain_result: keeps identifiers and requires an explicit user decision; never silently re-sends or rebinds
copilot_continuity.revocation: requires an explicit clean-thread decision; sent material remains in Microsoft
copilot_continuity.local_tests: 331 passed / 2 skipped; no authenticated Microsoft session

release_status: development build available at releases/nexo-tesis-v0.4.1-dev-windows.zip (rebuilt with Copilot365 no-API-key fix and tolerant academic JSON parsing); NOT a published release; remote Copilot continuity unverified

ready_to_use.external_requirement: Python >=3.11 with Tkinter and SQLite; package installs nothing
ready_to_use.bundled_dependencies: websocket-client and pypdf vendored in the package

development_package.self_check_branches_tested: failure (Tk missing on Linux) and success (Tk simulated)
